canonical_overlap.title: Manual daily-wage and overtime commands admit negative earning credits
canonical_overlap.covered_source: FIN-024 already cites RecordDailyWageHandlers.cs:33-60,77-108,125-156, including DailyWage, Overtime, and ExtraShift credit paths, plus PayrollRules.cs:95-109 and employee ledger paths. The root cause substantially overlaps signed earning admission; do not create a duplicate finding.
canonical_overlap.gap_in_canonical_crosswalk: FIN-024 source map does not cite EmployeeManagementHandlers.cs or EmployeeEditorViewModel.cs. SEM-MIRROR-057 adds the profile-input client/server validation divergence and BiometricCheckIn path. Recommend coordinator cross-link/extend FIN-024 source map and tests; no canonical change made here. FIN-022 is separate compensation-type casing behavior.

source_confirmed_behavior.behavior: Cashier employee form rejects negative daily/shift and optional monthly/overtime money values; zero passes and optional blank remains null.
Create/update require employees_manage and validate identity/CompensationType, then copy signed amount fields without amount guards.

Manual daily wage accepts custom or stored signed value; overtime accepts nullable signed custom rate and multiplies by hours; extra-shift uses positive ShiftValue else stored DailyWage, then posts result as credit.
Daily-compensation biometric check-in posts stored DailyWage through EmployeeLedgerPoster without positivity guard. Late penalty separately requires DailyWagePiastres > 0.
Poster accepts signed Money credit/debit, calculates balance, and persists passed signed values.
FromPiastres preserves the signed long; signed deltas are a primitive capability, not an issue by itself.
Payroll aggregates signed credit columns into category totals and floors only final net payable at zero. Inactive employee with no positive credit is omitted.
Profile and earning routes forward typed request values; handlers retain permission checks.
Inspected tests cover ordinary valid wage/overtime/extra shift, permission and duplicate handling, not negative profile/custom values or negative stored fallback.
Inspected tests cover ordinary positive payroll categories, not signed-negative credit aggregation or clamp behavior.

compensation_cross_challenge.impact_and_policy: Negative signed earning facts can lower ledger balance/category totals and may reduce positive net payable; the final payroll net cannot become negative. No employee was paid, no database call was made, and no realized loss is established. Normal WinUI blocks negative profiles; a privileged direct API caller remains required. Zero/null semantics are intentionally unresolved. Employee OvertimeRate is stored, but the reviewed RecordOvertime handler uses request CustomRate or global Settings; no claim that this field feeds that handler.
compensation_cross_challenge.recommended_owner_action: Keep FIN-024 canonical and cross-link SEM-MIRROR-057 as profile/biometric evidence. Confirm field-specific zero and negative policy. If negative earning values are disallowed, enforce server/domain constraints on profile and credit-producing commands with checked finite/range arithmetic, preserving legitimate null/zero. Do not globally ban signed Money or turn deductions into clamped zero credits.
required_tests_not_run: Negative profile values across daily/shift/monthly/overtime create and update; preserve owner-approved zero/null semantics.
Negative custom/stored daily wage, negative overtime rate, negative extra-shift fallback and extreme supported products reject before ledger persistence if policy disallows.
Biometric daily wage with negative/zero profile value follows explicit policy; duplicate event idempotency remains.
PayrollRules signed DailyWage/Overtime/ExtraShift behavior, output buckets, final net floor and inactive negative-only behavior are explicit.
Verify explicit deductions remain valid debit entries.

compensation_disposition: CORROBORATED_AND_CROSS-LINKED_TO_EXISTING_FIN-024; no duplicate finding ID. SEM-MIRROR-057 supplements source map. No auth bypass, actual input, DB write, payroll loss or settlement shown.
manual_source_review: Coordinator read the source bodies for all six listed callables and their directly relevant reporting/test/context references. Inventory and recipe handlers primarily write configuration; conditional financial effect depends on costing/report basis, policy or concurrent unit/recipe graph changes. Due-date update changes audited nullable aging metadata, not a payment. No runtime incident inferred.

validated_callables.reviewed_source_reasoning: Request-derived inv-{RequestId} replay occurs before authorization; new create requires inventory_manage, checks only nonblank Name, copies cost source and numeric metadata, and creates no stock or payable. Downstream FoodCostReport parses stored CostSource with Enum.Parse at ReportingQueryService.cs:391-396; authorized unknown string can cause costing-report failure. This is availability/data hygiene, not a changed money amount.
validated_callables.counterevidence: Normal UI may constrain the enum; request is permission-gated; no amount or stock is posted. InventoryVerticalSliceTests.cs:62-84 covers positive create, idempotent replay and permission, not invalid enum or negative thresholds.
validated_callables.remaining_action: Validate supported CostSource and threshold contract, or make financial report parsing fail safely; add invalid input tests if required.

validated_callables.reviewed_source_reasoning: Requires inventory_manage; unit change checks Any stock movement then rejects via InventoryRules.AssertUnitChangeAllowed; metadata then persists in SaveChanges. Sequential invariant is sound. There is no explicit transaction/version/conditional write between movement check and metadata save, so concurrent first movement vs unit update could reinterpret prior quantity under changed unit. No such interleaving is demonstrated.
validated_callables.counterevidence: InventoryVerticalSliceTests.cs:90-116 verifies metadata save, unit change allowed before movements and rejected after purchase receipt. It does not test concurrency. Handler itself changes no stock balance.
validated_callables.remaining_action: If invariant must hold under concurrency, serialize/check with a provider-backed guard and race-test first receipt against unit change.

validated_callables.reviewed_source_reasoning: Validates positive lines/active nonempty recipe, requires menu_manage, transactionally replaces recipe lines, and sets requested Product.RecipeId if active. Retargeting an existing recipe to a different product does not clear the old product backlink; food-cost report resolves historical sold lines through current product/variant recipe links and current recipe contents. This can change report basis after retarget but the report docs explicitly use current recipes, not historical snapshots.
validated_callables.counterevidence: Current-cost reporting is explicit; normal tests check creation/cost, line-set replacement and incomplete lines, not retarget/backlink uniqueness or historic-cost expectations. No stock/treasury posting.
validated_callables.remaining_action: Confirm whether recipe retarget is supported and whether recipe links are exclusive. If exclusive, clear old backlink atomically; if historical reports must freeze, version recipe/cost basis.

validated_callables.reviewed_source_reasoning: Validates output and line quantities and menu_manage authorization, checks direct/transitive self-consumption, then atomically replaces recipe. CostingRules yields unknown unit cost for cycles/incomplete inputs. Graph check is before transaction, so concurrent edits might race; no source/test evidence proves that a cycle was created.
validated_callables.counterevidence: InventoryVerticalSliceTests.cs:373-441 covers cost completeness, self-cycle, transitive cycle and shared-ingredient control. Atomic save protects a single recipe edit. Tests not executed.
validated_callables.remaining_action: If cycle prevention must survive concurrent recipe graph edits, serialize graph validation or test concurrent opposing changes with provider-backed execution.

validated_callables.reviewed_source_reasoning: Requires menu_manage and positive quantity; upserts by RuleId/request-derived ID, but does not canonicalize order type, require the item IsPackaging, or enforce one active rule/order type. CostingRules.OrderPackagingCost picks FirstOrDefault active match from unsorted rules; report applies one current rule cost per sold order type in selected range.
validated_callables.counterevidence: Duplicate rules do not multiply cost, but selected row may be unspecified. Existing test only saves/reads one delivery rule (InventoryVerticalSliceTests.cs:673-676); no duplicate-active test or confirmed one-rule policy. No stock or supplier posting here.
validated_callables.remaining_action: Confirm uniqueness policy. If one active rule/type is intended, enforce canonical types and uniqueness/upsert with duplicate-active test; otherwise define deterministic priority.

validated_callables.reviewed_source_reasoning: Requires purchasing_manage, loads invoice/lines/payments, updates nullable agreed due date and audit event in one SaveChanges; same date is no-op. Changes payables-aging classification, not payment, supplier balance or stock. No settled/cancelled guard; handler alone does not establish wrong outstanding amount.
validated_callables.counterevidence: PayablesAgingVerticalSliceTests.cs:150-202 covers adding date after receipt, clearing to unscheduled, already-expired terms and permission. Null/past due dates are intentional. No policy evidence that terms freeze upon payment/cancellation.
validated_callables.remaining_action: No action absent owner policy that due date edits stop after settlement; if so enforce state and test audit behavior.
